messages:
emma_fin: Hi team — VertexAI flagged duplicate reserved usage across two invoices after a cross-region failover. Disputed total USD 2,410 across INV-2026-721 and INV-2026-722. Requesting provisional SLA credit while we root-cause and reconcile.
josh_sales: cc @priya_platform @alan_revops. Customer is asking for the credit to avoid hold on payment — they want ETA and amount.
priya_platform: Need commit id + a short metering extract. Could be the cross-region streaming ingest re-emitted some batches.
emma_fin: Commit tag = rw-vertex-q3. Metering excerpt:```
2026-08-09T02:12:05Z commit=rw-vertex-q3 node=us-east1-a tokens=95K reserved=true
2026-08-09T02:12:13Z commit=replay node=us-east1-a tokens=9K reserved=true source=partner-retry
2026-08-09T02:12:29Z commit=rw-vertex-q3 node=europe-west2-b tokens=88K reserved=true
```
vendor_sync_bot: Vendor replay notice VND-7893: partner reported 7 replayed batches between 02:12:10Z-02:12:20Z for project vertex-project-id. Logs: https://partner.internal/replay/VND-7893
priya_platform: Looks like partner replay tagged as 'replay' but still marked reserved; our billing dedupe didn't catch cross-region duplicate keys. I can run a backfill that dedupes by (host, batch_id) to reassign those 9K tokens.
alan_revops: Provisional credit approval up to USD 2,500. GL: 5600 (Provisional SLA credits). Hold reason: 'pending partner replay attribution and backfill'. Please open BLG-11345 and attach excerpts. Need audit trail before final post.
emma_fin: Created BLG-11345, attached metering snippets and invoice PDFs. @josh_sales can you notify VertexAI with a provisional credit note and 72h ETA?
josh_sales: Sent interim note offering provisional credit up to USD 2,500 with ETA 72h. Will escalate if they push.
priya_platform: Backfill started. Reprocessed 4,612 metering events; dedupe maps 92% of disputed tokens back to single original batch. Proposed adjustment USD 2,286. Pushing reconciliation to BLG-11345.
alan_revops: Reviewing backfill audit now. Need host trace evidence for at least one representative batch and partner acknowledgement in BLG-11345.
emma_fin: Uploaded host traces and vendor acknowledgement to BLG-11345.
billing_bot: BLG-11345 updated: backfill completed; proposed credit USD 2,286; audit: https://redwood.internal/ops/billing/BLG-11345/audit
alan_revops: Approve final credit USD 2,286. Finance please post credit memo against INV-2026-721 and INV-2026-722, use GL 5600, then close BLG-11345.
emma_fin: Posted credit memo USD 2,286 and notified customer. VertexAI confirmed receipt and will reprocess payment. BLG-11345 -> closed.
billing_bot: BLG-11345 closed: provisional 2,500 -> final 2,286; GL 5600; audit link: https://redwood.internal/ops/billing/BLG-11345/audit
